scenes.topic_description:
Situation: You arrive at a local clinic for the first visit there. You are with your child, whose back hurts, and need to check in correctly so the consultation can happen without delay.
Learner: Parent. Partner: Receptionist.
Not in this scene: describing pain, understanding the diagnosis, treatment instructions, tests, buying medicine.
scenes.image_prompt: clinic reception desk with chairs in waiting area, realistic photo, warm light, no text, no logos, no faces in close-up

must_say: say where it hurts — slot: the part of the body
say when it started — slot: the time expression
say what makes it worse — slot: the movement or activity
answer whether there were other symptoms — slot: the symptom
ask what a word means — slot: the word
ask whether an activity is allowed — slot: the activity
ask how often to give something — slot: the medicine
confirm you understand the instruction — slot: the instruction
must_understand: asks where it hurts, since when, and what makes it worse
asks whether there are other symptoms
says the likely problem in simple terms
gives instructions for rest or medicine and how often to use it
tells you what activity to avoid and when to come back
scenes.topic_description:
Situation: In the consultation room, the doctor examines the child and explains what is likely causing the back pain. This is the key interaction because you are worried about understanding the instructions and what to do next.
Learner: Parent. Partner: Doctor.
Not in this scene: registration details, payment, pharmacy purchase, follow-up if the medicine does not help.
scenes.image_prompt: small clinic consultation room with doctor desk and examination chair, realistic photo, no text, no logos, no faces in close-up

must_say: say what medicine you need — slot: the medicine
say who the medicine is for — slot: the person
ask whether this medicine is available — slot: the medicine
ask how to give it — slot: the medicine
ask whether there are side effects — slot: the medicine
ask whether you need anything else — slot: the item
confirm the amount you need to pay — slot: the amount
must_understand: asks which medicine you need and who it is for
says whether the medicine is available
explains how often to give it
says the common side effects or warnings
tells you the total price
scenes.topic_description:
Situation: After the consultation, you go to a pharmacy to get the medicine or cream the doctor recommended for the child's back pain. It matters because you must understand how to give it safely.
Learner: Parent. Partner: Pharmacist.
Not in this scene: describing symptoms in detail, diagnosis, clinic registration, returning because treatment did not help.
scenes.image_prompt: pharmacy counter with shelves of medicine boxes behind it, realistic photo, no text, no logos, no faces in close-up

must_say: say the medicine did not help — slot: the medicine
say how the problem is now — slot: the change
answer whether you followed the instructions — slot: the instruction
ask whether you need another visit — slot: none
ask whether you need a different medicine — slot: the medicine
ask what to do until the next visit — slot: the time period
must_understand: asks whether the medicine helped and what changed
asks whether you followed the original instructions
says a follow-up visit is needed or not
explains whether the medicine should be changed
tells you what to do before the next step
scenes.topic_description:
Situation: The first treatment has not helped enough, so you return to the same doctor with the child. The purpose here is not the first diagnosis but explaining that the problem continues and understanding the next step.
Learner: Parent. Partner: Doctor.
Not in this scene: first check-in, first description of the pain, buying medicine, collecting test results.
scenes.image_prompt: clinic consultation room during a follow-up visit, parent seated with child near doctor desk, realistic photo, no text, no logos, no faces in close-up

must_say: answer whether the child can do the test today — slot: the time option
ask what test is needed — slot: the test
ask where the test will happen — slot: the place
ask when the results will be ready — slot: the thing (the results)
ask whether you need another appointment after that — slot: none
confirm you understand the next step — slot: the next step
must_understand: says a test or scan is needed
asks whether the child can do it today or another day
tells you where to go for the test
says when the results will be ready
explains whether you need to come back with the results
scenes.topic_description:
Situation: During the visit, the doctor decides that the child needs a test or scan before anything more can be decided. You need to understand the logistics of the next step in this new clinic system.
Learner: Parent. Partner: Doctor.
Not in this scene: first registration, full symptom description, medicine purchase, reporting that treatment did not help.
